newsitem.title: USA: CBOT corn seen flat to up one cent on soy support.
newsitem.headline: CBOT corn seen flat to up one cent on soy support.

text.p: CBOT corn futures were expected to open steady to one cent per bushel higher, supported by expected gains in soybeans and spillover strength from overnight trade, floor sources said.
Soybeans were seen climbing on rumors of Chinese interest in U.S. soymeal and South American soybeans, traders said.
Old-crop corn gains in overnight Project A trade were also seen giving the market an early lift. Old-crop contracts were up 1/4 to one cent, while new-crop December corn closed down 1/4 cent.
New-crop corn could labor under pressure from the ongoing timely planting of the crop, traders said.
